_meta.rule: Rule 1 — all analysis must cite this revision. Any deviation must be explicit.

geometry._tip_alt_note: CoM alt minus half-length; atmosphere-grazing variants lower; Likely
geometry._rotation_period_note: Derived: 2*pi*L / v_tip = 13.40 min at 2.5 km/s GTO/high-elliptical reference; Certain

kinematics._lower_tip_note: v_orb - v_tip - equatorial rotation = 7.55 - 2.5 - 0.465 ~= 4.59 km/s; Likely
kinematics._upper_release_note: v_orb_com + v_tip at release; evaluated for energy at upper-tip radius r=R_E+610+320=7301 km. The 2.5 km/s reference reaches GTO/high-elliptical class, not cislunar/TLI. [Certain]
kinematics._c3_note: C3 = v_rel^2 - 2*mu/r_tip with v_rel=v_orb_com+v_tip and r_tip=7301 km. At 2.5 km/s, C3 ~= -8.06 km^2/s^2 and apogee altitude ~=85,200 km, i.e. GTO/high-elliptical class but not cislunar/TLI. [Certain]

phase3_growth_option.note: Phase 3 growth option only, NOT the near-term Rev A reference: Mars-class escape remains possible at 3.5 km/s, but the integrated mass ratio is ~3086x and the case is launch-cost-dominated per financial analysis 2026-07-02. Escape (C3=0) is reached at ~2.9 km/s; full Mars-class C3 is the 3.5 km/s Phase 3 option.

kinematics._apogee_note: Derived from eps=v_rel^2/2 - mu/r_tip at the upper-tip radius; 2.5 km/s gives ~85,200 km apogee, while the 2.8 km/s cislunar option reaches lunar-apogee class. [Certain]

cislunar_revenue_gated_option.note: Revenue-gated option only, NOT the base-case reference: conservative economics at $500/kg customer price require construction launch below ~$686/kg for Y15 payback. At $800/kg construction launch, the breakeven customer price is ~$517/kg for Y15 payback. Requires a named cislunar anchor customer to validate open action #3.

materials._derate_note: 30% strength reduction for seams/joints/degradation is the conservative Rev A planning case; 0% and 15% are documented as optimistic/baseline sensitivity cases. [Likely]
materials.construction_baseline: Spectra/UHMWPE core + Zylon outer arm (Hoytether architecture)

integrated_tether_to_payload_both_arms.source: Moravec/Forward taper-optimized integrated tether mass formula; not EQ-5 peak area taper
integrated_tether_to_payload_both_arms.note: [Certain] The old EQ-5 peak taper entry has been removed because peak area ratio is not integrated tether mass. At the 2.5 km/s GTO/high-elliptical reference, integrated two-arm mass ratio spans 40.32x at 0% derate, 64.30x at 15% derate, and 121.83x at 30% derate. The 2.8 km/s cislunar revenue-gated option is 295.27x at 30% derate; the 3.5 km/s Mars-class growth option reaches ~3085.95x at 30% derate.
